notes.title: new games & fixes: No Man's Sky, Cyberdrifter ...
notes.content:
new games & fixes (updates automatically):

* NO MAN SKY PROBLEM is solved. Oh Yeah! That was incredibly hard. In NMS the movement follows a 3D vector of the joystick on the hand controller (in Stand Out, or Cyberdrifter as well). Whereas other games follow a projected 2D vector of the joystick (Onward, Fallout). We've learned a lot about quaternions, and how to intersect planes with rays using matrices, and many more.

* FALLOUT 4 Pipboy map is fixed and jump is added. Please reload community binding.

* [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/607760/CyberDrifter/?fbclid=IwAR3Yk9u-FF0QT_9JHvbmYums_EbWp8mS50obDCBJ8eoHiCb1YdJXadwvzlo]Cyberdrifter[/url] added!
* [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153460/Axegend_VR/?fbclid=IwAR3Yk9u-FF0QT_9JHvbmYums_EbWp8mS50obDCBJ8eoHiCb1YdJXadwvzlo]Axegend[/url] added!
* [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1291330/Wakamarina_Valley_New_Zealand/?fbclid=IwAR3Yk9u-FF0QT_9JHvbmYums_EbWp8mS50obDCBJ8eoHiCb1YdJXadwvzlo]Wakamarina Valley, New Zealand[/url] fixed
* [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/15051/VR_Exploration_Set/?fbclid=IwAR3Yk9u-FF0QT_9JHvbmYums_EbWp8mS50obDCBJ8eoHiCb1YdJXadwvzlo]VR exploration set[/url] (Iceland and Fushimi temple) added!

notes.title: The Walking Dead: Saints&Sinners
notes.content:
1) Our user interface is back. 

[b]* How to force an update[/b]:
On top left corner of desktop steam window: [b]choose STEAM then EXIT[/b].
Open steam again, now the update is detected.
Goto downloads, tell it to download now.
You [i]may [/i]need to launch Cybershoes [i]once [/i]after steamVR is started.
Or, just restart your PC ;)

2) TWD
Learn 
* how to use your own [b]physical stamina[/b] 
* how to run the game run on [b]Oculus[/b]
visit:
[url=https://www.cybershoes.io/twd]cybershoes.io/TWD[/url]

notes.title: 1st update that is brought to you via Steam
notes.content:
Bringing software to Steam - that alone is a reason to celebrate ːsteamhappyː
 But also a reason to[b] jump[/b]: finally we've found the bug that made you jump backwards.

Fixes in new update:
* [b]Jump fix[/b]
* [b]Trackpad classic HMD:[/b] yields now only forward speed (Spiderman fix)
* [b]Follow Cybershoes[/b]: improved stability
